text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGER fired for pool 'pool-gamma' — GPU memory pressure threshold breached (90%) on 3 hosts. Trigger: cuda_alloc_retry_failures > 50 in 5m

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered (High) — Incident ID PD-984321. Notified: mike (primary), sara (secondary).

mike (oncall): acked. I'm looking. Which jobs are the top alloc offenders?

sara (sre): seeing a bunch of `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in modelserver logs for model `redwood/psi-13b-q5`. tail of logs:```
[2025-11-03T22:14:07Z] modelserver[pid=2211] error: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2025-11-03T22:14:07Z] modelserver[pid=2211] error: cublasGemmEx: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED
[2025-11-03T22:14:07Z] modelserver[pid=2211] warn: kv-cache grow attempted, evicted 0 items
```

mike (oncall): thanks. Which hosts?

sara (sre): hosts: gpu-gg-17, gpu-gg-18, gpu-gg-19 in us-west-2; all in pool-gamma. Pod list: `kubectl -n infra get pods -o wide | grep pool-gamma` shows several long-running prefetch tasks.

alex (platform): grabbing scheduler metrics — I see sustained prefetch throughput from customer app 3489 causing large KV cache growth. That workload is pinned to pool-gamma due to routing policy.

oncall-lead: quick triage — customer-facing impact?

sara (sre): early signs: 429 spike for autocomplete endpoints for a subset of customers using psi-13b. Baseline 429s -> +8% tail over last 6m. No region-wide outage but degraded latency for those requests.

incident-bot: Auto-remediation suggestion: suggest `evict-prefetch` for pods with label app=prefetcher OR fallback routing to model `psi-13b-q4` (quantized). See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-memory-pressure

mike (oncall): ops plan: 1) acked 2) scale pool-gamma by +2 nodes (if capacity), 3) evict top prefetch pods, 4) enable routing fallback to q4 for psi-13b for 10m. I'll try evict first to avoid model switch.

sara (sre): running: `kubectl -n infra delete pod prefetch-3489-zz --grace-period=10 --force` on gpu-gg-17 (candidate).

infra-runbook: caution: deleting pods may trigger re-prefetch and extra memory churn. Prefer cordon + drain if sustained.

mike (oncall): understood. Doing quick delete on the biggest offending prefetcher.

[1m later]
sara (sre): deleted prefetch-3489-zz on gpu-gg-17. Memory freed ~42GB on that host per nvtop and collector metrics. Pressure dropped to 68% on gpu-gg-17, others remain high.

alex (platform): routing fallback applied for psi-13b -> psi-13b-q4 for affected customer 3489 as a safety net. Should reduce memory by ~40% per request.

pagerduty: PD-984321 acknowledged by mike at 22:16:41 UTC. Escalation suppressed.

mike (oncall): monitoring — still seeing OOM traces on gpu-gg-18 and -19. I'm going to preemptively cordon gpu-gg-19 and drain non-critical pods to prevent a kernel-level OOM.

oncall-lead: coordinate with infra to make capacity available in us-west-2; if we can't add nodes fast, consider cross-region routing to us-west-1.

sara (sre): dispatched: `kubectl cordon gpu-gg-19 && kubectl drain gpu-gg-19 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m`

incident-bot: pager auto-escalation timer 10m remaining.

[3m later]
sara (sre): drain started; 6 pods rescheduled (2 moved to us-west-1), 4 were critical and restarted on same host due to node constraints. Memory on gpu-gg-19 improved to 60%.

alex (platform): scaled pool-gamma +2 nodes (gpu-gg-20, gpu-gg-21) from spare capacity in region. Autoscaler used reserved capacity. New nodes joined healthy.

mike (oncall): good. Any remaining customers impacted?

sara (sre): 429s receded to +1% over baseline. Latency p50/p95 back to acceptable but tail still slightly elevated for customer 3489. We'll keep fallback for another 10m and then roll back if stable.

oncall-lead: decision: keep fallback enabled and mark incident as mitigated. Follow-up: run an eval to see quality delta for psi-13b-q4 on customer prompts, and recommend quantization profile adjustments.

mike (oncall): I'll create a short postmortem and schedule a deep-dive with model-onboarding to reduce prefetch footprint. Also will add an alert refinement: split prefetch and inference memory signals so prefetchers get isolated pages.

pagerduty: PD-984321 status: Resolved (mitigated) at 22:25:39 UTC — no further escalation.

incident-bot: Incident closed by auto-closure policy after mitigation metrics met.

sara (sre): noted root cause (immediate): aggressive prefetch + KV cache growth + single-pool routing. Probable contributing factor: model kv-cache growth not capped for q5 variant.

alex (platform): action items: (1) add per-job prefetch limits (2) add kvcache soft cap metric with alert (3) add automatic fallback to quantized model for high memory customers.

mike (oncall): handoff to day crew: please pick up follow-up ticket INF-2025 (created). I'm available if any regressions.

oncall-lead: thanks all — great rapid mitigation. :thumbsup:

infra-runbook: saved relevant logs to /var/logs/incidents/PD-984321.log and updated the runbook step that suggests prefer drain over delete in long-running prefetch storms.

mike (oncall): closing thread.

[end of thread]
